description:
You are a Computer and Information Systems Manager at a mid-size financial services firm. A third-party penetration test by CyberGuard Solutions has just completed, revealing 3 critical vulnerabilities in your vendor integrations that require immediate remediation under PCI-DSS compliance requirements.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Perform the following actions:

1. Go to the #security-alerts channel and find the critical penetration test report message from CyberGuard Solutions. Star this message for future reference.
2. Create a private channel named exactly: sec-remediation-2026-03-06
3. Set its topic to: Critical | CVE-2026-0142, CVE-2026-0198, CVE-2026-0215 | Remediation deadline: 2026-03-13
4. Invite the remediation team to the channel: ciso, security.analyst, vendor.liaison, compliance.officer, devops.lead
5. Post a vulnerability triage matrix message in the channel containing ALL THREE CVEs with their CVSS scores, affected systems, and remediation priority (Critical/High)
6. Pin your vulnerability triage matrix message
7. Reply in a thread on the original CyberGuard penetration test alert in #security-alerts, noting that a remediation channel has been created and the team is mobilized
8. Send a direct message to compliance.officer informing them that the vulnerabilities trigger PCI-DSS notification requirements and requesting they initiate the compliance reporting process
9. Send a direct message to vendor.liaison requesting urgent contact with PayStream and IdentityBridge vendor security teams for patch availability timelines
10. Post a status update message in the remediation channel confirming that containment measures are being evaluated and vendor contacts are being established
